highlights.title: 1 first-party subdomain CNAME-cloaked to third-party trackers
highlights.detail: DNS CNAME uncloaking linked adobe-ep.medicare.gov to Adobe Experience Cloud.

highlights.title: First-party server-side tagging detected on 1 endpoint
highlights.detail: First-party hosts (adobe-ep.medicare.gov) carried Adobe Web SDK (First-Party Edge).

highlights.title: 3 high-entropy fingerprinting or DOM-replay signals observed
highlights.detail: Detected webgl, audio, mutation-observer-replay across main.

highlights.title: 7 observed tracking companies not named in privacy policy
highlights.detail: Unmentioned in https://www.medicare.gov/privacy-policy: Adobe Experience Cloud, Index Exchange, Nextdoor, PubMatic, Tealium.

highlights.title: Contacted 30 third-party domains across 18 corporate groups
highlights.detail: 96 of 251 requests matched tracking services or Brave Shields filter rules (64 standard / 72 aggressive).
